name: io.github.bigabou007-dev/warimcp
title: WariMCP
description: AI-native payment MCP server for West Africa (WAEMU mobile money). Instructs licensed PSPs (FedaPay, and more) — no custody, bring your own keys.

environmentVariables.name: DATABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: PostgreSQL connection string. WariMCP persists transactions, payouts, and API keys.

environmentVariables.name: WARIMCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport: stdio (for MCP clients), http, or both. Use stdio for MCP.

environmentVariables.name: WARIMCP_MODE
environmentVariables.description: mock (deterministic, no keys needed), sandbox, or live.

environmentVariables.name: FEDAPAY_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your own FedaPay secret key (bring your own keys). Needed for the live FedaPay rail; omit in mock mode.
